articles.summary: Micron (MU) stock jumps 6% to new highs ahead of June 24 earnings as Needham raises its price forecast to a bullish $1,550.
articles._summary: Micron’s latest move follows renewed analyst optimism ahead of its June 24 earnings release. Needham analyst N. Quinn Bolton maintained a Buy rating and raised his price forecast to $1,550 from $500 on Monday. articles.author: Rishabh Mishra
articles.headline: Mark Zandi Says Top 20% Of Americans Now Account For Nearly 60% Of Spending As Bottom 80% Fall Behind Inflation
articles.summary: Moody's flags a "firmly intact" K-shaped economy. The top 20% drives spending as 80% lose the battle with inflation.
articles._summary: According to Zandi’s updated estimates, households in the top 20% of the income distribution—defined as those earning over $175k annually—now account for an “astounding nearly 60% of outlays.” Zandi noted this data presents an “overwhelming case” that the financial system is becoming “increasingly” unequal, leaving “most Americans… upset with their financial situations.” This economic data underscores a widening political rift over wealth distribution. Rep.
articles._zh_headline: 马克·赞迪 (Mark Zandi) 表示，收入最高的 20% 的美国人现在占支出的近 60%，而收入最低的 80% 的人却落后于通货膨胀
articles._zh_summary: 根据 Zandi 的最新估计，收入分配前 20% 的家庭（定义为年收入超过 17.5 万美元的家庭）现在占“支出的近 60%，令人震惊”。赞迪指出，这些数据提供了一个“压倒性的案例”，表明金融体系正在变得“日益”不平等，使“大多数美国人……对自己的财务状况感到不安”。这些经济数据凸显了财富分配方面日益扩大的政治分歧。代表。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Investors Flee Cathie Wood's ARKK ETF As It Trails S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 By Far
articles.summary: Cathie Wood’s ARK Innovation ETF is shedding assets this year as it continues to underperform the technology-heavy Nasdaq 100 Index.
articles._summary: Cathie Wood ’s ARK Innovation ETF (CBOE: ARKK) is shedding assets this year as it continues to underperform the technology-heavy Nasdaq 100 Index. Investors have withdrawn more than $313 million from the fund so far this year, bringing its assets under management down to $7.2 billion, well below its peak of $29 billion. The outflows stand in sharp contrast to the broader U.S. ETF market, which has attracted more than $1 trillion in inflows this year.
articles._zh_headline: 投资者逃离 Cathie Wood 的 ARKK ETF，因为它远远落后于标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克 100 指数
articles._zh_summary: Cathie Wood 的 ARK Innovation ETF（CBOE：ARKK）今年将剥离资产，因为它的表现继续落后于以科技股为主的纳斯达克 100 指数。今年迄今为止，投资者已从该基金撤资超过 3.13 亿美元，使其管理的资产降至 72 亿美元，远低于 290 亿美元的峰值。这些资金流出与更广泛的美国 ETF 市场形成鲜明对比，该市场今年吸引了超过 1 万亿美元的资金流入。

articles.author: Ananya Gairola
articles.headline: Nvidia Supplier SK Hynix Overtakes Samsung Electronics To Become South Korea’s Most Valuable Company
articles.summary: AI-driven demand for advanced memory chips helped SK Hynix briefly surpass Samsung Electronics as South Korea's most valuable company.
articles._summary: Shares of SK Hynix surged 5.7% during trading, lifting the company’s market capitalization to about 2,082.5 trillion won ($1.35 trillion), narrowly edging past Samsung Electronics at 2,081.3 trillion won, Reuters reported. The milestone marked a historic shift in South Korea’s corporate hierarchy, with Samsung having held the top spot since 2000. At the time of writing, SK Hynix stock was trading 4.7% higher at KRW 2,894,000 (about $1,884) in Seoul while Samsung shares were up 0.14% at KRW 354,500 (about $230).
articles._zh_headline: Nvidia供应商SK海力士超越三星电子成为韩国最有价值公司
articles._zh_summary: 据路透社报道，SK 海力士股价在交易期间飙升 5.7%，将该公司市值提升至约 2,082.5 万亿韩元（1.35 万亿美元），以微弱优势超过三星电子（2,081.3 万亿韩元）。这一里程碑标志着韩国企业等级制度的历史性转变，三星自 2000 年以来一直占据首位。截至撰写本文时，SK 海力士股票在首尔上涨 4.7%，至 2,894,000 韩元（约合 1,884 美元），而三星股价上涨 0.14%，至 354,500 韩元（约合 230 美元）。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: DRAM ETF Assets Hit $21 Billion AUM, But Key Risks May Lead To A Reversal
articles.summary: The fast-growing DRAM ETF has soared and crossed the $21 billion assets under management, but it faces some major risks
articles._summary: The Roundhill Memory ETF (CBOE: DRAM) continued its strong rally last week and reached a record high of $77.63, up by 173% from its lowest point in April, when it was launched. It has recorded inflows every week since its launch, with assets under management reaching $21 billion. This makes it the fastest ETF ever to reach that milestone. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, the other two biggest names in the industry, are also doing well.
articles._zh_headline: DRAM ETF资产管理规模达210亿美元，但关键风险或导致逆转
articles._zh_summary: Roundhill Memory ETF（CBOE：DRAM）上周继续强劲上涨，创下77.63美元的历史新高，较4月份推出时的最低点上涨173%。自推出以来，每周都有资金流入，管理资产达到210亿美元。这使其成为有史以来最快达到这一里程碑的 ETF。业内另外两家巨头三星电子和SK海力士也表现不俗。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Top Three Catalysts For Dow, Nasdaq 100, and S&P 500 This Week
articles.summary: Here are the top three catalysts for the Dow Jones, Nasdaq 100, and S&P 500 Index this week.
articles._summary: The S&P 500 , Dow Jones, and Nasdaq 100 indices have soared to their all-time highs this year, driven by the artificial intelligence supercycle and the strong earnings. They have soared by 9%, 6.50%, and 20%, respectively, this year. The rally stalled last week after the Federal Reserve delivered a hawkish decision , with nine officials pointing to higher interest rates this year. This article highlights the top three catalysts that will drive US stocks this week.
articles._zh_headline: 本周道琼斯指数、纳斯达克 100 指数和标准普尔 500 指数的三大催化剂
articles._zh_summary: 在人工智能超级周期和强劲盈利的推动下，标准普尔 500 指数、道琼斯指数和纳斯达克 100 指数今年飙升至历史新高。今年它们分别飙升了 9%、6.50% 和 20%。上周美联储做出鹰派决定后，涨势陷入停滞，九名官员指出今年将加息。本文重点介绍了本周推动美国股市上涨的三大催化剂。
